semiconductor_relevance: High — JEOL is a significant supplier of advanced electron optical and analytical systems used in semiconductor research and quality assurance.
summary: JEOL (Germany) GmbH specializes in providing ultra-high performance electron microscopes and high-precision lithography systems tailored for semiconductor applications. Their offerings include Scanning and Transmission Electron Microscopes, Electron Probe Micro Analyzers, and complementary preparation instruments, along with knowledge transfer opportunities through seminars and workshops.
